calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, cp.subcategory, p.subcategory AS sub_then, p.category AS cat_then, f.net_amount, f.quantity
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category = 'Garden'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
),
refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.subcategory, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT l.sales_line_id) AS dl, SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) AS ret, 
 ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0)/SUM(l.net_amount),2) AS rate, max(r.n) AS maxn, count(DISTINCT l.cat_then||l.sub_then) AS vers
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT category, subcategory, is_current, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT sku) AS skus, min(valid_from) AS mn, max(valid_from) AS mx, min(delisted_on) AS d1, count(delisted_on) AS delisted
FROM dim_product WHERE subcategory ILIKE '%light%' OR category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
SELECT 'ret_dup_id' AS chk, count(*) - count(DISTINCT return_line_id) AS v FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_dup_content', count(*) - (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sales_line_id, return_date, return_ts_utc, quantity_returned, refund_net, reason_code FROM fact_return_line))
FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_orphan', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_dup_id', count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_dup_receipt_line', count(*) - (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line)) FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'sku_no_current', count(*) FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sku_multi_current', count(*) FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_qty_gt_sold', count(*) FROM (SELECT r.sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY r.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount HAVING sum(r.quantity_returned) > f.quantity OR sum(r.refund_net) > f.net_amount + 0.01)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_before_sale', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.return_date < f.sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_neg_or_null', count(*) FROM fact_return_line WHERE refund_net IS NULL OR refund_net <= 0
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_neg_null_amt', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE net_amount IS NULL OR net_amount < 0 OR quantity <= 0

WITH dups AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id) AS nret
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH dups AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code, date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS mn_etl, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS mx_etl
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT s.store_id, o.status, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, count(r.sales_line_id) AS returned_lines, coalesce(sum(r.refund_net),0) AS refund
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND s.store_id=900
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE s.store_id IN (900,999) AND cp.category='Garden' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
